lockup.summary: Executives, directors and holders of 5% or more have agreed not to sell for six months after the offering closes. The lead underwriter can give written consent to allow exceptions.

what: Through its subsidiary Heliospace, Helio designs, builds and tests spacecraft hardware and provides space engineering services.
proceeds: It expects net proceeds of about $7.993 million. It plans about $1 million to repay notes and up to $4.25 million for research and development. The rest goes to sales, facilities, manufacturing and working capital.
risks: The company needs more money than it has and may not be able to raise it on good terms.
It has a history of missing payments on its loans. All have been resolved, but new ones could happen.
Its auditors have said there is serious doubt the company can keep operating.
It has weak internal financial controls, which could lead to late or wrong financial reports.
It has lost money every year, has built up large losses, and expects more losses.
